notes: 40 deterministic sequential synthetic joint-space targets per timing run; no hardware, no retarget or Ruckig timing
Timer wrappers are only enabled for a separate profile run; profile timings are inclusive and must not be summed
Prototype caches exact repeated configurations and feasibility results within one project call, broadphase uses finite positive geom_rbound for all geometry types
Reported geometry differences change actual motion/feasibility; this is not an apples-to-apples shape fidelity comparison
